0x03000022.name: Sora Fuzz
0x03000022.title: Bend Fuzz
0x03000022.basedOn: Sola Sound Tone Bender Mk II

0x03000022.why: Same code, but Valeton describes it three ways: Valeton Suite's file says Sora Fuzz, based on a Tone Bender Mk II; the GP-50 manual (p. 34) says Sora Fuzz, based on a Fuzz Face, word for word its text for Red Haze (likely copied by mistake); the GP-200 editor says Lazaro, based on a Big Muff (the GP-200's own Sora Fuzz is 0x03000026). Listen on both before copying.

0x0A000020.why: Same code, but Valeton's files disagree: the GP-50's says EV 4x12 ("Halen 4x12"), and the GP-50 manual (p. 43) says a Peavey 6505 4x12; the GP-200's says UK TD, a 1968 Marshall basketweave 4x12. The GP-200's own EV, 0x0A000023, is the Peavey 6505 4x12: if listening agrees with the manual, copy the GP-50's EV 4x12 to that one instead. Listen on both before copying.
